#Requires -Version 7.0
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Corrects two task texts of TODO IMPL-UNITGREEN-001 through the plugin (workflow.todo.update) after hostile
    validation round 1: task 9 records the wiki export as a declared block (goal item 4) instead of promising
    refreshed exports, and task 10 replaces the "mock gate 17/17" claim (finding F1) with the red run's
    denominator and the round 1 remediation. Refuses unless both tasks still start with their expected text.
    Every task stays unchecked; every other task text is sent back unchanged. Reads back. Supports -WhatIf.
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'CcPlugin.ps1')

Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
$g = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.get' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001' })
$todo = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue $g.Parsed 'payload') 'result'
$tasks = @(Get-CcValue $todo 'implementationTasks' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
if ($tasks.Count -ne 13) { throw "Expected 13 tasks, found $($tasks.Count)" }
$task9 = [string](Get-CcValue $tasks[8] 'task')
$task10 = [string](Get-CcValue $tasks[9] 'task')
if (-not $task9.StartsWith('FR-MCP-USECASE-016/017 converted', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { throw "Task 9 changed: $task9" }
if (-not $task10.StartsWith('Platform-dependent tests classified', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { throw "Task 10 changed: $task10" }

$newTask9 = 'FR-MCP-USECASE-016/017 converted into TR-MCP-USECASE-018/019 under FR-MCP-USECASE-001 and deleted (operator 17:03); the requirements wiki export is blocked on Linux (triage-report-a6927fca10364155ab9992506e1abc9c; retried 19:19:13 and 21:18:51), so under goal item 4 the stale docs/Project exports are declared in the PR and the HV brief instead of refreshed'
$newTask10 = 'Platform- and environment-dependent tests classified as integration tests: b2bd50b3 (UnitSuitePlatformScanner guard and strengthened skip guard; its first guard run unit-green-guard-mock-20261019T1720 was red: 4692 results, 1 failed, 16 not executed); hostile validation round 1 remediation 49cfec92 (one skip definition, interpolation holes; mock gate unit-green-r2-guard-mockgate-20261019T2103 4624/0/0) and b4ad42aa (36 native-boundary and tracked-file cases moved); Linux and Windows Test 4588/0/0 at b4ad42aa'
$updated = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt $tasks.Count; $i++) {
        $text = if ($i -eq 8) { $newTask9 } elseif ($i -eq 9) { $newTask10 } else { [string](Get-CcValue $tasks[$i] 'task') }
        [ordered]@{ task = $text; done = $false }
    })
Write-Output "BEFORE task9=$task9"
Write-Output "BEFORE task10=$task10"
if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('IMPL-UNITGREEN-001 tasks 9 and 10', 'workflow.todo.update')) {
    $u = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.update' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001'; implementationTasks = $updated })
    Write-Output "todo.update exit=$($u.ExitCode)"
    if ($u.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $u.Raw -match '(?im)^\s*type:\s*error') { Write-Output $u.Raw; exit 1 }
    $r = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue (Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.get' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001' })).Parsed 'payload') 'result'
    $after = @(Get-CcValue $r 'implementationTasks' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
    Write-Output ('READBACK tasks={0} tasksDone={1} done={2}' -f $after.Count, @($after | Where-Object { [bool](Get-CcValue $_ 'done') }).Count, (Get-CcValue $r 'done'))
    Write-Output ('READBACK task9 matches={0}; task10 matches={1}' -f ([string](Get-CcValue $after[8] 'task') -ceq $newTask9), ([string](Get-CcValue $after[9] 'task') -ceq $newTask10))
}
